where: Section 3, paragraph starting "P and any polynomial coefficients are unknowns"
problem: The text says initial conditions fix "any constants in the particular part". This contradicts the sentence just before it and the standard method: the unknown coefficients of the trial particular solution are found by substituting the trial into the recurrence, not from the initial conditions. A student who follows this will try to fit P from a_0 and get a wrong or over-determined system.
fix: Replace with: "P and any polynomial coefficients are unknowns found by substituting the trial into the recurrence. After p_n is known, the k initial conditions fix the k constants in the homogeneous part."

problem: The table notes the exceptional case only for the K·b^n row. A constant forcing is the case b = 1, so the constant row also needs the adjustment when 1 is a characteristic root; otherwise the table reads as if p_n = P always works for constant forcing.
fix: Make the row read: "constant C | P, unless r = 1 is a characteristic root, then P·n^m with m the multiplicity of the root 1".
